description:
I always tried to hide my feelings completely, just to keep my friendship with Cha Jae-hee from being ruined.

But one night when I was drunk, I accidentally revealed my feelings.

And what's worse... not to Cha Jae-hee, but to Park Tae-kyung!

"Looks like for a while... the three of us should hang out together, right? Jae-hee."

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Anytoon](https://www.anytoon.co.kr/webtoon/landing/episode/11377), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5265000572), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/The_Three_of_Us), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/play_with_three), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000075840), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13863394), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=260165)
